title: Help and feedback gives no other way to reach MettleUp when sending fails
what: The Help and feedback page has only a message box. When sending fails, the owner is told to check the internet and try again, even if the help service itself is down. The page shows no email address, phone or WhatsApp number. The MettleUp support email is shown only on the sign-in welcome screen, which an owner who is already signed in never sees.
expected: The Help and feedback page also shows the MettleUp support email (or another working contact) so an owner can still reach a person when the message box fails.
who: owners and desk staff who need help
how_often: whenever the help service cannot be reached
fix_line: Show the support email line under the message box on Help and feedback

title: Door machines are set up with one fixed web address typed in by hand
what: The setup steps tell the gym to type one MettleUp web address and port into each finger or face machine. If that address ever has to change (domain lost, host moved), every machine at every gym stops sending entries until someone at the gym types the new address on each machine. Nothing written says how that move would be done. The feature is not switched on yet.
expected: A written way to move machines to a new address, and the address kept on a domain whose renewal and ownership are recorded, before the feature goes live.
how_often: once, if the address ever changes
fix_line: Write the move-to-a-new-address steps and record who holds the gate domain before launch

items.reason: Data import: clear retry, undo and no-duplicate words. Support window: owner opens and closes it, every look listed. Set-up, billing and gym offboarding screens are not in this area (Setup, PayMettleUp, Settings).
Daily hand work for MettleUp from this area: answering help questions, AI credit top-ups, duplicate-serial and over-10-machines requests; all already recorded.

Every quoted button name in the articles for these 14 screens was searched in the screen files; only the diet plan Start from a sample line is wrong (already recorded). Entry machines have no article on purpose (not live).
Help box reaches the server; no fallback contact on the page; replies only reach the sending browser; entry machine errors say message MettleUp on WhatsApp with no number.
Screens hold no keys of their own; they use the device sign-in key. The one outside dependency fixed in this area is the door machine web address.
